raw_posts.name: zCAD AI
raw_posts.tagline: AI 3D that creates real parts, not just shapes
raw_posts.description: zCAD. AI is an AI-native platform for generating parametric 3D models, built for designers, makers and engineers. Describe a part or assembly in plain language, and zCAD. AI generates an editable, dimension-driven 3D model built on real CAD geometry, not a static mesh. • Complete assemblies from a single prompt, with mates between parts • Refine in plain language, or edit dimensions in a browser-based CAD editor • Export to STEP for use in any CAD tool

raw_posts.name: myPip
raw_posts.tagline: Vibe code, publish, and monetize games with AI
raw_posts.description: MyPip turns your game ideas into playable games you can publish and monetize. Describe what you want to build, and AI brings it to life directly in your browser, no coding required. Create multiplayer experiences, add in-app purchases and ads, and take your games beyond the browser to reach more players. From your first idea to publishing and monetization, MyPip gives anyone the tools to become a game creator.

raw_posts.name: 1Password for Agents
raw_posts.tagline: Let AI agents sign in for you without seeing your passwords
raw_posts.description: 1Password for Agents lets supported AI agents sign in to your accounts without ever seeing your passwords. When an agent hits a login, it asks 1Password. You approve or deny on your own device, and 1Password fills the password or one-time code directly. Connecting an agent doesn’t open your whole vault. Included in Individual and Family plans, with Meta Muse and Grok Bot rolling out and a waitlist.

raw_posts.name: AgentValley
raw_posts.tagline: Every Claude Code agent, at a glance, in your Mac's notch
raw_posts.description: It sits in your MacBook's notch. Every Claude Code session gets a card, every sub-agent gets a row, and each one has a little pixel programmer. You see who's working, on which model, and who's waiting on you. Free and open source.

raw_posts.name: Canva Craft
raw_posts.tagline: Turn prompts into design-ready images you can edit
raw_posts.description: Canva Craft is Canva’s first in-house image model, built for marketers, creators and designers who need images that work as designs, not just pictures. Unlike models trained mostly on photos that render pixels straight from a prompt, Craft learned from millions of Canva templates and plans the composition first, then renders it at 2K in 30+ aspect ratios. Expect legible text in 55 languages, precise placement and outputs you can split into editable layers. Live in Canva today, plus API.

raw_posts.name: LinkIntel
raw_posts.tagline: Post insights delivered direct to your AI
raw_posts.description: Your AI already drafts your X posts, but it has never seen how they performed. LinkIntel fixes that. Connect X once and it records how your recent posts do, every day. It also reads X's open-source ranking weights daily and links every change to its GitHub commit. Add one URL to Claude, ChatGPT, or your favorite agent harness and ask for a brief: your next draft starts from what actually worked for you

raw_posts.name: Many Displays
raw_posts.tagline: Zero clicks: windows back after sleep, unlock or replugging
raw_posts.description: Nothing to save, no layouts to name, nothing to click. Many Displays quietly remembers where every window lives (display, position, size) and puts everything back on its own when your Mac wakes, unlocks or reconnects its monitors. Grant Accessibility once and forget it's there. Built for identical monitors that macOS keeps swapping: it tells them apart, even by the port they're plugged into. No cloud, no account. $19 one-time, 14-day free trial.

raw_posts.name: Penta
raw_posts.tagline: A ’90s 5-disc CD changer on iPhone Duo
raw_posts.description: Penta turns your iPhone, iPad or iPhone Duo into a ’90s 5-disc CD changer for your Apple Music library. Every click, whir and tray motor is recorded from a real CD changer. On iPhone Duo the phone is the jewel case: close it and you’re holding the album, open it and the case opens with it, then drop the disc into the carousel. Hold it upright for a CD wallet over the tray that animates open and closed. Free, with an optional one-time Pro unlock for the real printed CD art.

raw_posts.name: Byter
raw_posts.tagline: Know exactly how much data you use, on every network
raw_posts.description: Byter shows how much internet data you use, and where. It tracks usage separately for every Wi‑Fi network, phone hotspot and wired connection, so you know exactly what your hotspot bundle went on. You also get live speed, a one-click speed test, daily-to-yearly charts, and gentle alerts when usage spikes. Everything stays on your device. No account, no ads. Available now for Mac, Windows coming soon, in 11 languages.

raw_posts.name: How It Went
raw_posts.tagline: Your route, photos and clips as a short film
raw_posts.description: Turns one ride or a whole trip into a short film from the GPS track, photos and clips you already have. Your track draws itself across a tilted map, each photo appears where you took it, and clips play where they were shot. Pick rides from Strava or bring Garmin FIT and GPX files. Several days merge into one film, rest days included. Fix a wrong camera clock once and every shot from it moves. Out comes an MP4, 9:16 or 16:9, assembled and encoded on your iPhone, Android phone or Mac.
